Leiria ( European Portuguese pronunciation: [lɐjˈɾi.ɐ] ⓘ ) is a city and municipality in the Central Region of Portugal . It is the 2nd largest city in that same region, after Coimbra , with a municipality population of 128,640 (as of 2021) [ 1 ] in an area of 565.09 square kilometres (218.18 sq mi). [ 2 ] It is the seat of its own district and the Roman Catholic Diocese of Leiria-Fátima . The city is part of the historical province of Beira Litoral .
